_status: HARVEST DRAFT — not applied. Candidate row for experience_patterns (P2).
name: illustrated-statement-block
display_name: An illustration beside a statement, with at most one link
description: A two-column block: an illustration on one side, a statement on the other, sides reversible. It has no behaviour, and recording that is the point.

contract.outcome: a real page load of the stated destination
contract.exists_only_when: the block's record carries a link URL
contract.evidence: template `{{if .link_url}}`; live about.html renders exactly one link (an external site)

states.outcome: nothing else in this block responds to a click, hover or key — the image is not a link, the statement is not expandable, the layout reversal is an author setting and not a control
states.why: **a contract that records 'inert by design' is worth an entry.** Without it, 'this component does nothing when clicked' is indistinguishable from 'this component's behaviour was never built', and the dead-control sweeps cannot tell them apart either. It is the inverse of the hollow-placeholder rule and it makes inertness checkable.
states.evidence: the whole template contains one anchor and one hover rule (an underline on that anchor)

degraded_states.outcome: the statement is the content and stands alone; the image is decoration in the layout sense

checks._unsupported: zero-count assertions do not exist — so 'inert by design' cannot be distinguished from 'unfinished' by any automated check we have (HARVEST_02 §3.4)
